requestCorrelation.behavior: Accepts an inbound correlation value truncated to 128 characters or generates a UUID; it is not an authentication credential.

telemetry.routeLabelPolicy: Use Express route template plus router mount path; if unavailable use /[unmatched]. Do not log query strings or raw request path parameters in slow-request telemetry.

implementedSharedRedactionWriters.control: Shared-route audit snapshot redaction; transaction-scoped audit failures propagate to abort the parent transaction.
Configuration audit snapshot redaction, including transaction-required audit helper.
Masked-call audit snapshots/security metadata redaction.
Suspicious GPS security audit metadata redaction.
Device mutation audit snapshot/security metadata redaction.
Consent audit snapshot/security metadata redaction.
Driver document audit snapshot/security metadata redaction.
InterCity connection handover audit snapshot/security metadata redaction.
Provider delivery-result audit snapshots/security metadata redaction.
Authoritative trip finalization audit snapshots/security metadata redaction.
Direct transaction-bound app-link/commission/matching audit snapshots apply shared redaction in addition to existing Admin redaction.
Password-authentication audit security metadata applies shared recursive redaction.
Payment and Razorpay reconciliation audit snapshots/security metadata apply shared redaction; audit failures inside supplied transactions are propagated.
Payout audit failures propagate if written through a caller transaction.
Transaction-bound booking audit failures propagate.
Transaction-bound rating audit failures propagate.
Transaction-bound trip audit failures propagate.
Driver audit snapshots are redacted and transaction-bound write failures propagate.
Event booking transactional audit snapshots/security metadata are redacted.
Bulk OTP configuration transactional audit snapshots/security metadata are redacted.

providerAudit.durabilityAndRetention: Durable provider state persists records; retention/archive/deletion authority remains pending. At 5000 retained records, audit append fails closed rather than silently evicting history; a dedicated approved archive/purge path is required before production.

alertAndMonitoringRequirements: Track elevated 5xx/error rate with bounded alert frequency.
Track slow route counts and latency by route template, not full requested URL.
Monitor database readiness and schema/migration state separately from HTTP liveness.
Track realtime outbox backlog/age/replay gaps and Provider/Gateway queue age/retries/final failures.
Track authentication failures, OTP attempt-limit events, permission denials and privileged configuration changes without logging secrets.
Admin observability data access must remain permission-gated.
openItems: Confirm whether caller-provided x-request-id needs strict character validation or replacement for unsafe values.
Decide durable audit retention/archive/deletion policy, preserving approved security and legal requirements.
Add dedicated metric persistence/dashboards/alert delivery only after requirement and infrastructure approval.
Run final-phase tests for query-secret non-disclosure, redaction, alert thresholds, audit coverage and permissions.
Complete final source-wide audit producer inventory and field-level allowlisting; shared redaction currently covers the principal route audit helpers but not every inline producer.
Complete remaining source-wide log and inline audit review; centralized 4xx/5xx payload redaction is defensive coverage, not a replacement for per-route safe error handling.
Choose/approve a durable Provider audit archive/retention/deletion schedule and an operational response to the fail-closed 5000-record capacity gate before production.

providerRouteErrorDisclosure.rule: Provider Gateway, Provider, Admin and Gateway-auth route errors use safe error codes; some legacy message-based status mapping remains for reviewed migration.

routeLoggingPrivacy.rule: never raw req.originalUrl/query strings; telemetry uses route templates and bounded mount labels.

protectedActionOtpGrantAudit.evidence: Grant issuance writes the hashed grant and mandatory audit in one transaction. Grant consumption, mutation and required audit share the caller transaction; runtime concurrency and redaction tests remain deferred.
